name: WireGuard-ESPRack
description: Static-allocation fork of WireGuard-ESP32-Arduino. Drop-in API compatible with ciniml/francescolavra forks; eliminates heap allocations in the handshake + transport hot paths so the WireGuard tunnel doesn't fragment heap on every up/down cycle. Designed for ESP32-C3 deployments with tight contiguous-heap budgets.
keywords: wireguard, vpn, network, esp32, esp32-c3, static-allocation
